What can I do for you two? We got some lovely new fruits in.''"
"''What about the melons?''"
"''Execellent choice. Their in season. Fresh from Ukio. I'll find a good one.|Vendor to Bix Caleen|}} A [[human]] '''vendor''' worked at [[Samo's]], a small bodega on [[Coruscant]], during [[3 BBY]]. They had tan skin, [[color|green]] eyes and a white [[hair|beard]]. While working at the shop they sold to [[Bix Caleen]] and [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] at least twice. During the later time they sold the pair three [[Unidentified Ukio melon|Ukio melon]]s from [[Ukio]], a packet of [[Peezo]]s and a spicy [[Moski pepper]]. On that day, They wore an orange [[clothing|vest]] over brown shirt and a gray-green [[hat]]. ==Behind the scenes== The vendor was portrayed by [[Howard Ward]] and appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's fourth episode, "[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]," which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 29]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ბოდეგას უცნობი ვაჭარი }} [[Category:Coruscanti]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
